title: BorgWarner Performance Turbocharger Catalogue - Porsche 993 Turbo
notes: PDF page 56 lists Porsche 993 3.6 biturbo (1994-1997 in this table), stock K16-6735 + K16-6736, stock power 408 hp and commercial stock-turbo capacity 500 hp. Upgrade references 5324 988 7003 + 7004 are listed as plug-and-play with commercial capacity 555 hp. Published unit hp is retained, not silently changed to PS. Continuous/temporary T3 950/980 C belongs to the upgrade table; it is not a measured stock K16 gas temperature, rotor-metal temperature, material certificate or allowable additive-design limit. Capacities describe the turbo application, not verified engine strength/durability. No exact stock K16 compressor/turbine map obtained.
